d: Belgium is rocked by a massive nationwide anti-austerity movement as up to 70,000 demonstrators flood Brussels to protest Prime Minister Bart De Wever's proposed spending cuts, pension reforms and declining purchasing power. The demonstration turns tense near Brussels-Midi station, where groups of protesters clash with riot police, vehicles are set ablaze and officers deploy tear gas and water cannons.
